Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTS AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF CHEMICALS ARE BEING RELEASED TO THE GROUND AND A LAKE ON THE PROPERTY. THAT MATERIALS ARE BELIEVED TO BE PESTICIDES AND AN UNKNOWN CHEMICAL THAT IS USED TO MAKE THE GRASS GREEN. CALLER STATES THAT THE USE OF THESE CHEMICALS MAY HAVE SEEPED INTO THE LAKE AND NOW CHANGED THE COLOR OF THE WATER MAKING IT A TURQUOISE. CALLER STATES THAT THE WATER FROM THE LAKE FEEDS A STREAM BEHIND THEIR HOUSE THAT LEADS TO THE FRENCH BROAD RIVER. THE CHEMICALS MAY ALSO BE IMPACTING WILDLIFE SUCH AS CANADIAN GEESE, FISH, AND TURTLES IN THE AREA. THEY ALSO FEEL THAT THESE MATERIALS HAVE A POTENTIAL TO SEEP INTO WELLS IN NEIGHBORING AREAS. FIRST TIME IN 21 YEARS THEY HAVE SEEN A DISCOLORATION OF THE LAKES WATER. CALLER STATES THAT THERE ARE USUALLY GEESE AT THE LAKE BUT THEY ARE NOT THERE TODAY LEADING THEM TO BELIEVE THE GEESE SENSE THERE IS SOMETHING WRONG WITH THE WATER.

Report DescriptionA POSSIBLE OIL ANOMALY WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. REPORT DATE: 09-03-2021 REPORT TIME: 0630 UTC REGION: GULF OF MEXICO SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: SOUTH TIMBALIER 41 IMAGE DATE: 09-02-2021 IMAGE TIME: 1638 UTC DATA SOURCE: SENTINEL2B MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 10 METER LOCATION: 28°56"06" N/90°10"49" W AREA: 7.96 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: HIGH REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE ANOMALY APPEARED TO EMANATE SOUTHEASTWARD FROM A POINT SOURCE IN THE GULF OF MEXICO APPROXIMATELY 10 NMI S OF PORT FOURCHON, LA, AND MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 6.8 NMI IN LENGTH AND UP TO 0.8 NMI IN WIDTH. THE ANOMALY APPEARED FAINTLY DARK AGAINST ITS BACKGROUND, WITH A PROMINENT STREAK OF WHITE AND BROWN COLORING SUGGESTING POSSIBLE THICKER OIL, WITH POSSIBLE SIGNS OF FEATHERING. WINDS AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE AROUND 9 KTS FROM THE WSW. THE ANOMALY WAS GENERALLY CO-LOCATED WITH A PREVIOUS MPSR ASSOCIATED WITH NRC REPORT #1315630. UNCERTAINTIES: THE ANOMALY EXTENDED BEYOND THE EDGE OF THE IMAGE AND SO THE AREA OF THE SLICK WAS UNDERESTIMATED. THE EARLIER MPSR ASSOCIATED WITH THIS ANOMALY LISTED A DIFFERENT POINT SOURCE; THIS IMAGE SUGGESTED A POINT SOURCE FURTHER WEST FROM THAT ONE. SEVERAL OIL FACILITIES WERE IN THE VICINITY OF THE SUSPECTED SOURCE POINT.

properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 848155 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: MAVERICK TUBE L.P.
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 848155
Incident Time: 2007-09-07 13:00:00
Nearest City: Conroe, TX
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: HYDRAULIC OIL (SHELL AW HYDRAULIC OIL 32)
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: MAVERICK TUBE L.P.
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 5 feet by 7 feet (area 35 sq. ft.)
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
INFORMATION TAKEN FROM A WEB REPORT/// ON SEPTEMBER 1, 2007, A HYDRAULIC LEAK WAS REPAIRED ON A HOSE USED TO POWER A MECHANISM TO MOVE PIPE. THIS MECHANISM IS LOCATED INSIDE THE MILL BUILDING. THE HOSE WAS CONNECTED TO A 100-GALLON HYDRAULIC TANK RESERVOIR. APPARENTLY THE HYDRAULIC OIL SEEPED OUTSIDE OF THE BUILDING WHERE IT LAY UNDISCOVERED UNTIL TODAY, SEPTEMBER 7, 2007. DUE TO THE HEAVY RAINS THE FACILITY SUFFERED THE DAY BEFORE, THE OIL MADE IT'S WAY INTO THE STORM WATER DITCH. AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF HYDRAULIC FLUID WAS RELEASED. THE INCIDENT WAS DISCOVERED DURING A ROUTINE INSPECTION OF THE PLANT DITCHES. A VISIBLE SHEEN WAS OBSERVED ON THE WATER LEAVING THE FACILITY. A NEARBY SPILL KIT WAS USED TO ABSORB ANY FLOATING OIL EXITING AT THE FACILITY AND IN ANY IMPACTED DITCHES. THE IMPACTED SOIL IMMEDIATELY OUTSIDE OF THE MILL BUILDING WAS EXCAVATED AND WILL BE DISPOSED OF AS CLASS ONE INDUSTRIAL WASTE AT THE WASTE MANAGEMENT LANDFILL LOCATED IN CONROE, TEXAS. A WASTEWATER SAMPLE WAS ALSO COLLECTED AT THIS TIME. ANALYTICALS WILL BE COMPARED TO THE EFFLUENT LIMITATIONS IN NPDES PERMIT NO. WQ0002365000.
